results.question: What is the total revenue?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM orders

results.question: How many orders were placed?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders

results.question: What is the average order value?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(revenue)*1.0/COUNT(*) AS avg_order_value FROM orders

results.question: Revenue by region
results.sql: SELECT regions.region_name AS region, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM orders JOIN regions ON regions.region_id = orders.region_id GROUP BY regions.region_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

results.question: Revenue by category
results.sql: SELECT products.category AS category, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM orders JOIN products ON products.product_id = orders.product_id GROUP BY products.category ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

results.question: Revenue and profit by category
results.sql: SELECT products.category AS category, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(revenue-cost) AS profit FROM orders JOIN products ON products.product_id = orders.product_id GROUP BY products.category ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

results.question: What was revenue in July 2026?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-07-01' AND order_date < '2026-08-01'

results.question: Show monthly revenue from January through September 2026.
results.sql: SELECT substr(order_date,1,7) AS month, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY substr(order_date,1,7) ORDER BY month

results.question: What was revenue last year?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01'

results.question: What was revenue last month?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-09-01' AND order_date < '2026-10-01'

results.question: Revenue in the last 30 days
results.sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-09-22' AND order_date < '2026-10-22'

results.question: Top 5 products by revenue
results.sql: SELECT products.product_name AS product, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM orders JOIN products ON products.product_id = orders.product_id GROUP BY products.product_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: Top 2 products per category by revenue
results.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT products.category AS category, products.product_name AS product, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM orders JOIN products ON products.product_id = orders.product_id GROUP BY products.category, products.product_name), ranked AS (SELECT category, product, total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS rk FROM grouped) SELECT category, product, total_revenue FROM ranked WHERE rk <= 2 ORDER BY category, rk

results.question: In which months did revenue exceed 400000?
results.sql: SELECT substr(order_date,1,7) AS month, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM orders GROUP BY substr(order_date,1,7) HAVING SUM(revenue) > 400000.0 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

results.question: Why did revenue drop in July compared to June?
results.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT products.category AS category, SUM(revenue) AS v FROM orders JOIN products ON products.product_id = orders.product_id WHERE order_date >= '2026-07-01' AND order_date < '2026-08-01' GROUP BY products.category), targ AS (SELECT products.category AS category, SUM(revenue) AS v FROM orders JOIN products ON products.product_id = orders.product_id WHERE order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY products.category), merged AS (SELECT base.category AS category, base.v AS base_value, COALESCE(targ.v, 0) AS target_value FROM base LEFT JOIN targ ON base.category = targ.category UNION ALL SELECT targ.category AS category, 0 AS base_value, targ.v AS target_value FROM targ LEFT JOIN base ON base.category = targ.category WHERE base.category IS NULL) SELECT category, base_value, target_value, (target_value - base_value) AS delta FROM merged ORDER BY delta ASC

results.question: Customers with sales above average
results.sql: WITH agg AS (SELECT customers.customer_name AS customer, SUM(revenue) AS m1 FROM orders JOIN customers ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id GROUP BY customers.customer_name) SELECT customer, m1 FROM agg WHERE m1 > (SELECT AVG(m1) FROM agg) ORDER BY m1 DESC

results.question: What is the median order revenue?
results.sql: SELECT revenue FROM orders

results.question: What is the 90th percentile of revenue?
results.sql: SELECT revenue FROM orders

results.question: What is the standard deviation of revenue?
results.sql: SELECT revenue FROM orders

results.question: How many distinct customers do we have?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customers.customer_name) AS distinct_customer_name FROM orders JOIN customers ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id

results.question: What is the maximum revenue?
results.sql: SELECT MAX(revenue) AS max_revenue FROM orders
